AppointmentComplete.description:
Body of `POST /appointments/{id}/complete`: the visit, exactly as `POST /visits` minus the
customer (the appointment's). Same rules: server prices, full payment, discount (D10).

check_in_at.description:
When the service happened. Default: arrival time, else the booked start if already
past, else now. Same day rules as `POST /visits` (owner may back-date).

duration_min.description: Default: the services' durations (empty = 60) rounded up to the slot. 1 slot – 480.

note.description: Booking note, ≤ 500 characters. Not for health data.

service_ids.description: 1–5 services, in the order they will be done.

starts_at.description: On the spa's slot grid, inside opening hours; today up to 90 days ahead (past days: owner).

customer_id.description: Null for a newcomer not yet linked to a customer record.

customer_name.description: The customer's name, or the newcomer's.

paid_amount.description: Collected by the visit (after discount); 0 until done.

duration_min.description: Current catalog duration; null = "theo tư vấn".

AppointmentUpdate.description: Body of `PATCH /appointments/{id}` (If-Match): reschedule or edit an open appointment.

customer_id.description: Link a newcomer to the customer record created for them (replaces the guest name/phone).

staff_id.description: Absent = unchanged, null = no preferred technician (not allowed once arrived).

CalendarDto.description: `GET /appointments`: the spa's grid and its appointments over `from..=to`.

technicians.description: Columns of the day view; their count is the spa's capacity per instant.

health_note.description: Present only for callers with `customer.health_notes.read`; null = no note.

CustomerKind.description: What kind of customer a re-engagement row is.

cancelled_at.description: Set when the package was cancelled (a voided sale or a cancellation with refund).

sale_id.description:
The sale it was sold in. `null` for a package migrated from the paper books, which
otherwise looks like any other package (EM 2026-11-05: no "sổ cũ" label in the product).

sold_price.description: Price paid after discount, in đồng.

status.description: Derived on read: cancelled → exhausted → expired → active.

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service (e.g. "Chăm sóc cổ vai gáy").

per_session_value.description: Value of one purchased session in đồng (bonus sessions are worth 0).

days_since_last_visit.description: Days from the last completed visit to today.

paid.description: Money received from this customer (before voids and refunds).

CustomerSummaryDto.description: Search hit for the counter: never contains notes.

technicians.description: Technicians who worked that day, most visits first.

customers.description: Distinct customers with at least one completed visit.

one_off_services.description: One-off services performed in completed visits.

packages_sold.description: Packages sold in sales that are not voided.

sessions_used.description: Package sessions taken by completed visits.

DayHeadline.description: The headline numbers of another day, for "so với hôm qua / cùng thứ tuần trước".

FollowUpCreate.description: Body of `POST /customers/{id}/follow-ups`. The recorder is the signed-in user.

contacted_on.description: Day of the contact; default today (spa time zone). Not in the future, at most 30 days back.

next_follow_up_on.description:
When to try again (≥ `contacted_on`, ≤ 365 days after it). Omitted: `no_answer` → contact
day + 3, `will_come` → + 7, `not_interested` / `other` → none.

note.description: ≤ 500 characters. A contact note, not a health note.

FollowUpFilter.description:
`GET /customers/inactive?follow_up=`, judged on the follow-ups of the current absence
(recorded on or after `last_seen_on`; a visit since then starts a new absence).

has_more.description: More than 100 exist (only the newest are listed).

not_interested_pause_days.description: Days a `not_interested` customer stays out of `GET /customers/inactive?follow_up=due`.

today.description: The spa's business day the suggestions are computed from.

GuestCreate.description: A newcomer known only by name and phone until they arrive.

health_note.description: null or empty clears the note.

HistoryEvent.description: One entry of a customer's timeline; exactly one of the detail fields is set, per `kind`.

paid.description: Money received for the one-off lines (before any void).

amount.description: Price of a one-off line (0 for a package session).

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service.

customer_package_id.description: The package the session came from (`source = package`).

sessions_left_after.description: Sessions left in that package item right after this visit.

reversed.description: Money given back by reversal (positive amounts).

due_on.description:
When this contacted customer is due again: `next_follow_up_on`, or for `not_interested`
without a date, contact day + 90 (shown once more then). `null` = not contacted in this
absence (already due) or nothing due.

oneOf.description: Latest follow-up since `last_seen_on`; `null` = not contacted in this absence.

last_seen_on.description: Latest of: last completed visit, last sale not voided, last package start.

next_follow_up_on.description: The date that follow-up planned for the next try (`null` = none planned).

KindSplit.description: One amount split like the paper revenue book: package sales vs one-off services.

LastFollowUp.description: The latest follow-up of the current absence.

by.description: Name of the user who recorded it.

LedgerDay.description: Daily subtotal of the book, for every day of the range (not only the current page).

days.description: Days of the range that have entries, in order.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next rows; `null` on the last page.

LedgerRow.description: One line of the "sổ theo dõi doanh thu hằng ngày". Outgoing money is negative.

id.description: The sale id (`sale`, `void`) or the refund id (`refund`).

note.description: Discount reason, void reason or refund reason.

one_off.description: "Dịch vụ 1 lần" column: the one-off services, comma-separated.

unpaid.description: "Chưa thanh toán": total − received (always 0 in R1, which collects in full).

voided.description: The sale was voided later (its `void` row may be on another day).

LoginNext.description: What the browser must do after the password step.

LoginResponse.description:
Body of a successful password step. `me` is only present once fully signed in: a session that
still owes a second factor learns nothing about spas or permissions.

Me.description: Body of `GET /me` and of a successful login.

MethodSplit.description: One amount split by how the money moved.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code, or (for `verify`) one of the recovery codes.

MfaEnrolled.description: Result of confirming enrollment: signed in, plus the recovery codes (returned this once only).

MfaEnrollment.description: Enrollment material, shown only to the pending session that started enrollment.

manual_key.description: The same secret in base32, for typing into an authenticator app by hand.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://totp/...` URI; the client renders it as a QR code.

oneOf.description: A new customer profile, created in the same transaction (needs `customer.write`).

customer_id.description: An existing customer of this spa. Send exactly one of `customer_id` and `customer`.

customer_created.description: True when `customer` was sent and a new profile was created.

sessions_bonus.description: Bonus sessions in the original package (default 0).

sessions_purchased.description: Paid sessions in the original package.

sessions_remaining.description: Sessions still unused today, ≤ purchased + bonus.

name.description: Package name; defaults to the plan's name. Required without a plan.

package_plan_id.description:
The current plan this old package matches, if any (reference only: items and price are
what the paper book says).

sold_price.description: Price the customer originally paid, in đồng (for the per-session value; not revenue).

starts_on.description: Original registration date (not in the future).

refund_amount.description:
đồng paid back now, 0 = no refund. At most what the customer paid for this package
(`sold_price`), else `422 refund.exceeds_paid`.

expires_on.description: The new last day of validity: later than the current one and not in the past.

counts.description: Over the whole spa (or the `q` match), ignoring `status` and the cursor.

days_to_expiry.description: Days from today to `expires_on` (negative once expired).

last_used_on.description: Last completed visit that used this package.

PackageUsage.description: `GET /customer-packages/{id}/usage`: one page of the paper "sổ theo dõi liệu trình".

uses.description: Oldest first, like the paper page (STT 1, 2, 3…).

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service.

voided.description: The visit was voided and its sessions were put back.

reversal_of.description: `reversal` rows: the payment this one cancels (same method and amount).

PaymentStateDto.description: "Đã thanh toán chưa": R1 collects in full when the visit is recorded.

PhoneCheckDto.description:
`GET /customers/phone-check`. `taken` → `existing_id` + `full_name` name the profile to open
instead of creating a duplicate (create would answer `409 customer.phone_taken`).

valid.description: The input is a complete, valid phone number (false while still typing).

PricesInput.description: Prices in đồng: either `all`, or `female` and/or `male` (a missing gender = not offered).

end.description: Last day of the bucket (clipped to `to`).

net_revenue.description: `revenue.net.total`, flat for line charts; only with `report.revenue.read`.

start.description: First day of the bucket (clipped to `from`).

RangePreset.description:
Ready-made periods, computed on the server from the spa's own "today" (its time zone), so
every device agrees on what "this month" is. Each has a default granularity.

oneOf.description: The preset the range came from, if any.

series.description: Every bucket of the range in order, empty ones included (continuous charts).

technicians.description:
Every technician who worked in the range, most visits first (same counting as the daily
dashboard: a visit counts once per technician however many lines they did).

top_services.description: Top 10 by sessions used + one-off services.

totals.description: Whole range; `customers` = distinct customers over the range.

code.description: Current TOTP (or a recovery code); required when the account has MFA enabled.

RefundDto.description: Money paid back when the package was cancelled (US7).

Revenue.description:
Money of a day or a period, cash basis, from the append-only `payment` and `refund` rows.
A void never deletes the original payment: it adds a reversal on the day of the void, so a
sale voided the next day still counts on its own day and shows as a void on the next.

collected.description: Money received (`payment.kind = 'payment'`), discounts already taken off.

refunds.description: Money paid back when a package was cancelled (always a package).

voids.description: Reversals of voided sales, booked on the day of the void.

SaleCreate.description:
Body of `POST /sales`. Prices are never read from the client: unknown fields such as
`unit_price` or `total` are ignored and every amount is computed from the catalog.

closer_staff_id.description: The staff member who closed the sale (must be currently working here).

payments.description: 0–2 payments, one per method, summing exactly to the total (R1 collects in full).

void_reason.description: Set when the sale was voided (US6); its payments then each have a `reversal`.

gift_note.description: Gift note for this package; omitted = the plan's, empty = none.

ServiceDiscountCreate.description:
Discount on the one-off lines of a visit (spec appointments.md §5): **either** `percent` or
`amount`, never both. The server computes the amount (`percent` → floor of subtotal × % / 100).

amount.description: đồng, 1 ≤ amount ≤ subtotal of the one-off lines.

ServicePrices.description: Validated price set of one service.

StaffDto.description: Basic staff card: no phone or personal data (`staff.read_basic`).

SuggestedNextOn.description:
The next date the rules would store for a contact made today, per outcome (`null` = none).
The form pre-fills `next_follow_up_on` with it; whatever the user leaves there is sent.

not_interested.description: None: they leave the "due" list for `not_interested_pause_days`, then come back once.

will_come.description: Today + 7: check in if they still have not come.

visits.description: Completed visits in which this technician did at least one line.

revenue.description: Sum of their prices after discount; only with `report.revenue.read`.

sold.description: Packages sold in sales that are not voided.

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service (e.g. "Gội đầu dưỡng sinh").

one_off_revenue.description: List price of the one-off services; only with `report.revenue.read`.

VisitCreate.description:
Body of `POST /visits`. No amount is read from the client: unknown fields such as `unit_price`
or `total` are ignored, one-off prices come from the catalog and the customer's gender.

check_in_at.description:
When the service happened (giờ làm), not when it is typed. Defaults to now. At most
5 minutes ahead of the server and on today's business day; with `visit.backdate` (owner)
up to 366 days back, and the visit, its sale and payments then belong to that day.

oneOf.description:
Discount on the one-off lines (D10: `sale.discount` up to the spa's cap,
`sale.discount_unlimited` beyond; reason required).

note.description: Session note incl. reactions (health data): needs `customer.health_notes.write`.

payments.description: For the one-off lines: 0–2 payments, one per method, summing exactly to their total.

business_date.description:
Business day of the service (`check_in_at`), which may be before `created_at` when the
owner entered it late.

note.description: Present only on a single visit and only for `customer.health_notes.read`; null = no note.

sale_id.description: Sale of the one-off lines (none when the visit only used package sessions).

subtotal.description: Sum of the one-off lines before discount.

total.description: Amount collected in this visit (one-off lines after discount).

void_reason.description: Set when the visit was voided (US6): it stays in history with the reason.

customer_package_item_id.description:
`package` lines: the package item to use; omitted = the customer's usable package for this
service that expires soonest, then the oldest (AC4.3).

expiry_override_reason.description: `package` lines: use an expired package anyway (needs `package.use_expired_override`, audited).

oneOf.description: `one_off` lines for a customer without a recorded gender: which gender price applies.

staff_id.description: Technician who performed the line (required, must be working here).

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service (e.g. "Gội đầu dưỡng sinh").

discount_amount.description: One-off: this line's share of the visit discount (0 for package lines).

line_value.description:
One-off: qty × unit price − discount share (paid now); package: value of the sessions
taken (bonus = 0).

sessions_left_after.description: `package` lines: sessions left on the item right after this visit, of `sessions_total`.

unit_price.description: One-off: listed price; package: value of one paid session.

VisitUpdate.description: Body of `PATCH /visits/{id}` (with `If-Match`): corrections that do not touch money or sessions.

note.description: Absent = unchanged, null or empty = cleared. Needs `customer.health_notes.write`.

reason.description: Why the record is voided (required, 1–500 characters); shown in history and audited.
